title: Modifying Amyloid Motif Aggregation Through Local Structure.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结合ThT实验与GROMACS分子动力学模拟，研究tau蛋白IDR中局部结构（β-发夹）如何遮蔽淀粉样基序并调控聚集，直接涉及IDP构象与互作机制建模，方法为物理模拟，高度契合课题。
abstract: Protein assembly into beta-sheet-rich amyloid structures is a general biophysical phenomenon that has significant biological consequences, most notable for their prominent association with neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's, Huntington's, or Parkinson's diseases. The assembly of amyloid structures is driven by short sequences called amyloid motifs. In many neurodegenerative diseases, intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) self-assemble through amyloid motifs, but these motifs are present in all proteins, including folded globular proteins. Importantly, mechanistic knowledge is lacking for how IDPs, which do not adopt a stable tertiary structure, mask these amyloidogenic motifs to mitigate or slow the formation of beta-sheet-rich amyloid structures that cause disease. Our recent work has shown that local structural elements can modify the aggregation propensity of amyloid motifs in the intrinsically disordered microtubule-associated protein tau by adopting metastable beta-hairpin-like structures that shield the amyloid motif, and disease-causing mutations change the conformation, thus increase aggregation propensity (Chen, Nat Commun 10:2493, 2019). Here we describe a protocol that correlates experimentally determined aggregation propensities for peptides measured by the Thioflavin T (ThT) fluorescence aggregation assay with their conformational ensembles derived from Groningen machine chemical simulations (GROMACS). Integration of experiment and simulation will help uncover structural rules behind changes in conformation that modulate protein aggregation. We anticipate that our general protocol will help identify key interactions in local structures that engage amyloid-forming motifs in IDPs which influence aggregation behavior.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质组装成富含β-折叠的淀粉样结构是一种普遍的生物物理现象，具有显著的生物学后果，最值得注意的是它们与神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、亨廷顿病或帕金森病）的显著关联。淀粉样结构的组装由称为淀粉样基序（amyloid motifs）的短序列驱动。在许多神经退行性疾病中， intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 通过淀粉样基序自组装，但这些基序存在于所有蛋白质中，包括折叠的球状蛋白。重要的是，对于不采用稳定三级结构的IDPs如何掩盖这些淀粉样生成基序，以减轻或减缓导致疾病的富含β-折叠的淀粉样结构形成，目前缺乏机制性认识。我们最近的工作表明，局部结构元件可以通过采用亚稳态的β-发夹样结构来屏蔽淀粉样基序，从而修饰 intrinsically disordered microtubule-associated protein tau 中淀粉样基序的聚集倾向，而致病突变会改变构象，从而增加聚集倾向（Chen, Nat Commun 10:2493, 2019）。在此，我们描述了一种协议，该协议将实验测定的肽段聚集倾向（通过硫黄素T (ThT) 荧光聚集测定法测量）与其构象系综（源自Groningen machine化学模拟 (GROMACS)）相关联。实验与模拟的整合将有助于揭示构象变化背后的结构规则，这些变化调节蛋白质聚集。我们预期，我们的通用协议将有助于识别IDPs中参与淀粉样形成基序的局部结构中的关键相互作用，这些相互作用影响聚集行为。
